_about: Weapons whose recalibration pulled talents from the wrong pool until Ubisoft fixed it. Copies recalibrated before the fix can carry a talent that is not in their pool (the Source lists in weapon-talent-sources.json), so a creator's screenshot can show a pair the game no longer rolls. The planner shows these as a note instead of a warning, and the weapon pages say so.

fixes.summary: Our summary of the official bug fix (/patch-notes/season-2-phase-1-the-call/): the Classic AK-47 recalibration only gave LVL2 talents, and a few other weapons rolled talents from the wrong pool on recalibration (First Wave Vector 45 ACP, RPD, M700 Carbon, M700). Fixed.
fixes.source: https://thedivision.fandom.com/wiki/Season_2_Phase_1_-_Patch_Notes (mirror of the official developer post; summarized on /patch-notes/season-2-phase-1-the-call/)
